articles.headline: A tiny hinge part may be behind iPhone Duo screen failures
articles.summary: Apple’s first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo, hit store shelves last week to considerable lines and long wait times for preorders. But some customers who were lucky enough to get their hands on one of the $2,000 phones have been reporting an unfortunate problem: The inner screen of the phone can break, showing horizontal bright lines emanating from the phone’s hinge. CNBC's MacKenzie Sigalos speaks to iFixit lead teardown technician Shahram Mokhtari to find out what could be going on.

articles.headline: New research examines how GLP-1 drugs could affect the labor market
articles.summary: Weight-loss drugs like Ozempic and Wegovy are becoming increasingly popular among Americans, but their impact could extend well beyond personal health. New research suggests that GLP-1s could influence everything from hiring decisions to workplace productivity. Meanwhile, employers are facing questions about whether covering these expensive medications is worth the cost, and whether the potential benefits for their workforce justify the investment.
